decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted EX00, EX01, EX02, EX03, EX04, EX05, EX06 received 16/01/2012, Design and Access Statement received 13/04/2012, P01 rev B, P02 rev C, P03 rev B, P04 rev B, P05 rev B received 26/04/2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional, giving specific details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension, excavation of a rear lightwell and construction of an external staircase and excavation of a front light well to the ground floor flat
